name: Evt_GetSceneVariants
notes: comevtbl[mode][scene]; -1 marks the end of the mode's scene list (op 0x4F)

name: Evt_TaskStart
notes: Task entry: installs Evt_Run 0x0045ECC0 as the task body

name: Stage_End
notes: 0x009C71C0 = 1, 0x009A5C48 = 0; game mode 6 (unless sub-state 8): sub-state 5 + 0x0041D350. Called by op 0x4F at the end of a mode's scenes

name: Stage_ResetState
notes: Clears enemy/boss counters 0x009C904A / 0x009C7006 / 0x009CA0E8, flags 0x009C7200 (256 B), light angles, 0x009CA098, 0x009C6F1C/20, 0x009C71C0 ...; called by Stage_Start and modes 10/11

name: Evt_OpRoute1Spawn
notes: Ops 0x01-0x04: if route 0x009C8E84 == 1 run 0x00577650[op] (spawn09/0a/0b/0c), else skip the -1 list

name: Evt_OpSpawn0A
notes: Op 0x0A: per record task(0x009A2280[type], 0x13F4), Actor_SetFlags(0), state = rec[1]

name: Evt_OpSet71D4
notes: Op 0x16 (16 B): three dwords via pointers -> 0x009C71D4/D8/DC

name: Env_StartLightAngleTask
signature: void __cdecl (int pitch, int yaw, int frames)
notes: Task 0x0040E3B0 (0x4C) with the current env +0x18/+0x1C angles and target (a, b), c; presumably interpolates the light angles

name: Env_InterpChannel
notes: Ops 0x21/0x25: channel interpolation record (0x009C89E0 / 0x009C8920; 16 B {active, current, target, step}), step given; 16 B (8 for sub > 10)

name: Env_InterpChannelFrames
notes: Ops 0x23/0x27: target, step = (target - current) / frames (negated if negative); sub 2-5 targets are ints, others pointers

name: Evt_OpPlayerBonus
notes: Op 0x2B (4 B): per player in state 5 above a threshold: 0x004156C0(i 0x00567990[...])

name: Snd_PlayVoiceLine
notes: Line table 0x0058B6B8 (+0x009C7000 offset outside game modes 10/11) -> sound 0x00589DB4[i*16], task 0x00435AA0; suppressed while skipping

name: Evt_OpCameraStartReady
notes: Op 0x32: yields until both players ready (0x00579CE0[state*5] or lives > 0), then like 0x31

name: Evt_OpCameraSetState
notes: Op 0x33 (12 B): command state 0x009A1A10 = a, pending 0x009A2C8C += b

name: Snd_PlayRepeated
signature: void __cdecl (int id, short count, short interval)
notes: Plays now, task 0x00435E90 replays count-1 times every interval frames (stops while skipping)

name: Evt_OpWaitQueue
notes: Op 0x40: yields while pending 0x009A2C8C != 0; with pending 0 continues in the same frame (if running 0x007DCCA4)

name: Evt_OpWaitFrames
notes: Op 0x42: counter 0x009C8904 = n on first call; continues on the (n+1)-th following frame

name: Evt_OpWaitEnemies
notes: Op 0x44: live enemies 0x009C904A <= arg, running, camera settled, 0x007DCCA8 > 0 (failed checks)

name: Evt_OpPerPlayerLoadPol
notes: Op 0x49: skip 0x009C9118 lists, Res_RequestPolFile per entry, skip to -2

name: Evt_OpStageReset
notes: Op 0x4D: camera reset (tick 0, 0x00403BB0(1,3), ticks remaining 0x7FFFFFFF, roll off ...), table 0x009A2BE0 defaults, scene log 0x009A5920

name: Evt_OpLoadPol
notes: Op 0x52: Res_RequestPolFile; game type 1 remaps 0xBE/0xBF by character (0x009A2242 / 0x009A2256)

name: Evt_OpUnloadTex
notes: Op 0x55: Res_RequestType7 (pairs with 0x54 in the scripts: texture unload)

name: Res_FlushLoadRequests
notes: Processes queued requests of type < 8 and keeps the rest

name: Res_FlushRequests8To10
notes: Processes queued requests of types 8-10 and keeps the rest

name: Snd_StartBgm
signature: void __cdecl (int a, int b, int id, int d)
notes: Snd 0x80000000 (stop), then Snd(id); debug string SS_Event_ENTRYBGM_BG_core

name: Cam_Task
notes: Camera task body: 0x009C6F2F = 0, mode function 0x00576B10[0x009C6F08], context functions 1-3, Cam_BuildViews (which commits 0x009C6F0C/14 -> 0x009C6F08/10)

name: Cam_Init
notes: Cam_ResetContexts, 0x00403BD0(1,1), queue indexes/pending 0, command state 0x009A1A10 = 2, context functions nop

name: Cam_ResetContexts
notes: 4 contexts pos/target from 0x0059C990, active 0, 0x00403BD0(0,0), 0x009C6F2C/2D/6FD8 = 0, light/env reset

name: Cam_ProcessQueue
notes: Calls ctx0 command, pops blocks from ring 0x009C9060 (read 0x009A34D0, write 0x009CA108) while command state 0x009A1A10 is 1 (now) or 2 (start, run next frame); type -> 0x005776EC[t>>4][t&15]; copies 8 words to ctx0+0x184. Verified by replay

name: Cam_ModeEvent
notes: Mode 1: Cam_ProcessQueue, then for sub 3 context 2 = copy of context 0

name: Cam_SetMode
notes: Like Cam_RequestMode and also sets current 0x009C6F08 / 0x009C6F10

name: Cam_SetupEvent3
notes: Mode 1 sub 3: active context 0x009C6F00 = 2, rail 0x0040C380, player functions

name: Cam_CmdSegment
notes: Block type 0x40 {start, end, cam, flags}: start == end -> Cam_CmdPose; flags & 2 -> Cam_CmdDefer; else Cam_CmdPlay

name: Cam_CmdPose
notes: Evaluates one tick (start) into the context; done

name: Cam_CmdDefer
notes: Rail segment for the shooting camera: 0x009A2D78 = cam, 0x009C70AC = start (-1: tick+1), 0x009C70B0 = end, 0x009C70B8 = flags; done

name: Cam_CmdPlay
notes: Starts Cam_PlayStep at start (-1: continue; flags & 4: deferred start/end), end tick +0x148

name: Cam_PlayStep
notes: (refined) tick 0x009A6110 = +0x144, evaluate, 0x009C6F28 = end - tick, +0x144 += 1, done at end (end-start+1 frames). Verified by replay

name: Cam_CmdWait
notes: Block type 0x13: n frames (0x00403290); n = 0 -> 0x00420810 (never done)

name: Cam_CmdPreset
notes: Block type 0x20 {frames, pose}: pose 0x00576CF0[pose] (pos, target); 0x009C6F2D = 1; done after frames (0 = never)

name: Cam_CmdShoot
notes: Block type 0x21 {sub}: state 3, Cam_RequestMode(2, sub), 0x009A5900 |= 1, ctx0 fn = 0x00576B20[sub]; never done (op 0x31 ends it)

name: Cam_CmdLookTable
notes: Block type 0x60 {t0, c0, t1, c1, t2, c2}: 0x009C6FD8 = 1, (tick, camera) per route branch 0x009C88A4 for 0x00403DB0

name: Cam_LookTableEval
notes: (refined) 0x009C70BC / 0x009A2D78 from the look table entry 0x009C88A4; ctx+0x110 = tick; evaluates into the rail pose 0x009C70C0 / 0x009C70D8

name: Cam_ShootStart4
notes: Sub 4 start: Cam_ShootInit, players at the camera, rail look point (0,0,-30); fn = Cam_ShootStep

name: Cam_ShootStart6
notes: Sub 6 start: Cam_ShootInit + look point; fn = Cam_ShootStep

name: Cam_ShootStart7
notes: Sub 7 start: Cam_ShootInit, 0x009C6F2D = 1, state 0; fn = Cam_ShootFollowRail

name: Cam_ShootFollowRail
notes: Context 0 = rail pose 0x009C70C0/D8; 0x009C6F2D = no lock-on target; tick = (int) 0x009C70BC

name: Cam_ShootStep
notes: State 0x009C6F20 = 2 (no enemies 0x009C904A / 0x009C7006 and no lock-on) or 3; 6 if 0x009CA094; 7 if 0x009C6F30/32; dispatch 0x00576CBC; tick = (int) 0x009C70BC. Verified by replay

name: Cam_ShootReturnTurn
notes: Settled (0x009C6F2D): Cam_Evaluate into context 0. Else 0x00402E60 + 0x00402F80 (two evaluations), then signed cos^2 > 0.99999 -> settled

name: Cam_TurnToRail
notes: Cam_Evaluate(cam, tick) -> look-at 0x009C6FA8; target rotated by 0x00403C00 (step 0x00576C0C)

name: Cam_ShootTrack
notes: State 3: position = rail (0x00402EF0), look-at from targets (0x00403050), rotate (0x00403C00); no Cam_Evaluate

name: Cam_TargetLookAt
notes: Look-at 0x009C6FA8 = mean of the lock-on slots' +0x100 positions (0x009A5EC0.. 4 x {u8 on, ptr}), or the rail look point 0x009C70D8 (0x0059C988 = 0)

name: Cam_RotateToward
signature: void __cdecl (float* pos, float* lookAt, float* target, float* out, int num, int den)
notes: Rotates the view direction toward the look-at point by num/(num+den) of the angle (matrix stack); not ported

name: Math_Lerp
signature: float __cdecl (float a, float b, int wb, int wa)

name: Math_SignedCos2
signature: float __cdecl (float ax, float ay, float az, float bx, float by, float bz)

name: Rail_Step
notes: jmp [0x009C7080]; called by task 0x00414F10 after the camera task

name: Rail_Event
notes: Mode 1 sub 3: player position 0x009C71E0.. from the camera matrix and a (0, -15, 0) offset (exact frame not checked)

name: Rail_StandStart
notes: Sub 4: rail position 0x009C70C0 = context 0 position; then 0x0040C470: player position, 0x009C6F28 = -1

name: Rail_MoveStep
notes: If 0x009C70AC < 0x009C70B0: += 1 when 0x009CA098 == 1 || 0x00413280() || (0x009C8E8C == 0 && 0x009C8E80 != 0); 0x009C70BC = tick; Cam_Evaluate -> rail pose; 0x009C6F28 = end - tick. Verified by replay

name: Rail_Task
notes: Task body jmp Rail_Step (task order after Cam_Task)

name: Sys_Nop2
notes: Empty function (camera state 6 / block type 0x13 with 0 frames)

name: Game_UpdateMode
notes: Per frame (Game_Update): Actor_InitTypeTable when sub-state 0, switch on game mode 0x009C8E98 (3 title, 4, 5 demo, 6 game, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16), then 0x004067D0

name: Mode_Commit
notes: End of Game_Update: if 0x007C17A0 >= 0: 0x009C8E98 = it, sub-state 0x009C90A4 = 0, resets

name: Mode_CheckStart
notes: Start pressed (0x00404460) after > 2 frames: title -> mode 4; attract modes 5/9/10/11 -> title

name: Mode_AttractDemo
notes: Game mode 5: demo table 0x00589828[0x009A3400] (20 B: event mode, scene, frames, key offset, bgm, -, bgm id, key file); Stage_Start(...,1); ends when 0x007DC90C == 0 -> next demo, Mode_Next

name: Demo_LoadKeys
notes: (refined Res_LoadEtc) Reads etc\<key file> (PRS) into 0x009A2228 (+offset): recorded demo input

name: Stage_Start
notes: Resets, preloads, flushes requests, creates the stage task 0x00460710, Rail_Reset, Stage_ResetState

name: Stage_Task
notes: Creates in order: Evt_Init, Env_InitInterp, Cam_StartTask, 0x004134D0, 0x00414F20, 0x00414ED0, 0x00414FB0, 0x00413950, 0x004809D0, 0x00401470, 0x004138A0, 0x00408D90, 0x00409080, 0x00404480, Demo_TimerTask (mode 5)

name: Stage_RunTasks
notes: Runs the stage task's children (0x004A7240), 0x004607B0, counters 0x009C8E08..

name: Mode_Adv
notes: Game mode 10: event mode 10 (advevtbl), scene 0, task 0x0041FAB0; ends on 0x009C71C0 (Stage_End) -> Mode_Next

name: Mode_09
notes: Game mode 9: event mode 8 (no stage table), task 0x00499F90 (instructions/how to play?)

name: Mode_04
notes: Game mode 4 (after start on the title)

name: Player_TryJoin
notes: Credit/start check (0x00413230 0x00406DC0); Mode_Request(6) when not in game

name: Game_ResetAll
notes: Boot-time reset (from Game_InitData): game mode 0 (Mode_Next -> 10), players, camera mode 0, Evt_LoadCommonTable
